text:
Sam C.: quick day0 readiness check for Mosslane private deploy — listing the top gaps we hit in the dry run: egress firewall not allowing our collector IPs, KMS CMK policy missing source-vpc condition, CloudTrail forwarding to their SIEM needs log-format tag mapping, IAM role for model-serving cross-account still in review. tagging @Jess O. @Liam N. for ops/net. link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-onboard#mosslane

Jess O.: saw the firewall denies in the packet captures. I raised ticket NET-3242 to request the 3 CIDRs. Mosslane team said they need the exact ports too. can you confirm ports we require? :thinking:

Liam N.: ports: 443 outbound to storage, 4500 for kv-cache replication only between our pods (if using IPsec), 514 UDP/TCP for log-forwarder. short command to validate route table: ```aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0abc1234 Name=association.main,Values=false``` run from their infra account or we won't see their peering routes.

Anna E.: on KMS: their default CMK policy currently allows account root actions. we need a key policy with explicit principal and a condition limiting SourceVpc. brief snippet I suggested to them: ```{ "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-kms-access"}, "Action": "kms:Decrypt", "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abc1234"}} }``` they asked about rotation window and whether we require automatic rotate-on.

Sam C.: rotation: we prefer AWS-managed rotation on customer CMKs for auditability unless they have a specific offline HSM requirement. note: this customer will require 7d retention on token sessions per compliance.

Jess O.: re: CloudTrail -> SIEM: format mapping needed. they use a custom field "env:prod" tag. Our forwarder expects `resource_type` in the JSON. I'll send the mapping table in a separate message. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: Mosslane day0 -> preflight dry-run (id: dr-1764135) starts 2024-09-02T14:00:00Z. Expected duration 2h. Participants: samc, jess-o, liam-n.

Liam N.: small gotcha — their peering uses transitive NAT which strips source IP in some flows; for KV cache replication we need original source. asked them to enable preserve-ip on the tunnel.

Anna E.: also flagged audit logs retention: they currently set 30d. Compliance requires 90d for their sector. need to confirm cost acceptance or offer compressed S3 lifecycle.

Sam C.: action list: (1) Jess to share port+mapping table to Mosslane and NET-3242 update, (2) Liam to confirm preserve-ip change and route-table visibility, (3) Anna to send KMS policy snippet + rotation recommendation, (4) I'll set a short 30-min sync after they apply firewall changes to validate forwarding and CMK policy. target: validate by EOD Fri. Thanks team :pray:
